criteria.name: stops_on_dup_txn
criteria.description: On a held-out extract with one transaction id recorded in two transaction exports, the program exits nonzero and writes no report.

criteria.name: stops_on_unknown_env
criteria.description: On a held-out extract with a transaction naming an envelope the register of record lacks, the program exits nonzero and writes no report.

criteria.name: stops_on_bad_correction
criteria.description: On a held-out extract with a correction at or below the cutoff naming a transaction no export holds, the program exits nonzero and writes no report.

criteria.name: stops_on_no_fit
criteria.description: On a held-out extract with a fee statement that no assignment of keeping rates to the keeping plans meets, the program exits nonzero and writes no report.

criteria.name: stops_on_two_fit
criteria.description: On a held-out extract with a fee statement that two assignments of keeping rates to the keeping plans meet, the program exits nonzero and writes no report.

criteria.name: stops_on_bad_crc
criteria.description: On a held-out extract with a tx_c.bin trailer that differs from the checksum of the bytes before it, the program exits nonzero and writes no report.

criteria.name: program_except_clauses_named
criteria.description: Every except clause in /app/out/transform.py names the exception classes it catches and re-raises, reports or records the error instead of discarding it.

criteria.name: program_functions_at_most_sixty_lines
criteria.description: Every function in /app/out/transform.py is at most 60 lines long.

criteria.name: finishes_in_time_on_largest_plan_count
criteria.description: On held-out extract 19, which has 11 keeping plans, the program finishes within 60 seconds, exits with status 0 and writes the five household reports the documents define for it.

criteria.name: negative_hardcoded_sample_answers
criteria.description: The program carries shipped-extract answers as literals or replays the shipped sweep on a held-out extract.

criteria.name: negative_reads_outside_allowed_scope
criteria.description: The program opens a file outside DATA_DIR, OUT_DIR and its own directory.

criteria.name: negative_forbidden_facility
criteria.description: The program uses a network connection, a third-party module, a subprocess, fork or pool, a clock read or random, uuid or secrets.

criteria.name: negative_location_dependent_output
criteria.description: The reports change when the extract, working directory or output directory moves.

criteria.name: negative_writes_outside_out_dir
criteria.description: The program modifies the extract or writes outside OUT_DIR.

criteria.name: negative_nondeterministic_reports
criteria.description: Two runs on the same extract at the same location give different reports.
